description: Generate real ULIDs: 48-bit millisecond timestamp plus 80-bit crypto randomness in Crockford base32.

faqs.a: The first 10 chars encode the millisecond timestamp; the last 16 are 80 bits from crypto.getRandomValues.
Crockford base32 (0-9, A-Z minus I, L, O, U) — 26 characters, URL-safe and case-insensitive.
Yes — batch-generate up to 500 at once, then copy or download them.
faqs.q: Can I generate many at once?

faqs.a: It uses the WebCrypto API, which is cryptographically secure.

howto: Choose how many ULIDs to generate (1–500).
Copy them or download as a text file.
